svg.aria-label: The two compatibility gates on the example of section 1.2: gate 1 compares the CUDA that the host driver supports with the CUDA the app was built with, and gate 2 matches the SASS or PTX in the fatbin against the compute capability of the GPU.
svg.title: The two compatibility gates on the example of section 1.2: gate 1 compares the CUDA that the host driver supports with the CUDA the app was built with, and gate 2 matches the SASS or PTX in the fatbin against the compute capability of the GPU.

g.text: host
nvidia.ko and libcuda.so
supports CUDA up to 12.2
container image: the app
CUDA runtime 12.4
libcudart
fatbin
SASS sm_80, sm_90
GPU: H100
compute capability 9.0
gate 1
gate 2
gate 1: driver and runtime
the CUDA of the driver must be at least the CUDA of the app, or the
same major with the driver at or above the floor (12.x: 525.60.13)
runs by minor-version compatibility
12.4 on a driver that supports 12.2: the same major, and 535.183.01
is above the floor 525.60.13; the app has SASS for the GPU
the limits of minor-version compatibility
the driver cannot JIT-compile PTX from the newer toolkit: error 222
an API newer than the driver fails: error 36
a CUDA 13.0 build fails with 35: a newer major
with cuda-compat 13.0 it runs on the H100, because R535 is a
kernel-driver branch that this package supports (verify); over R560
it fails with 803 (branch), and on an RTX 4090 with 804 (hardware)
a libcuda.so copied into the image fails with 803 (§6.4)
gate 2: kernel image and GPU
SASS sm_XY runs on CC X.Z with Z at least Y;
PTX compute_XY JITs to CC at least X.Y
the driver loads the SASS
sm_90 matches CC 9.0 (sm_80 runs on 8.0, 8.6, 8.9, never on 9.0)
no JIT, no slow first start
no SASS matches: the driver JIT-compiles the PTX
compute_80 JITs to 8.x, 9.0, 10.0, 12.0 and up: the first start
is slow, and the driver caches the result in ~/.nv/ComputeCache
no kernel image is available: error 209
no SASS for this CC and no usable PTX: for example, a wheel
built for 8.0 8.6 9.0 without +PTX on an RTX 5090 (12.0). With
9.0+PTX the wheel runs there, but it still fails on a T4 (7.5),
because the driver JIT-compiles PTX only upward
only compute_80 PTX under minor-version compatibility: error 222
gpusim.compat.check() walks both gates in this order; the error codes are the rows of §1.4 (gpusim.compat.ERRORS)
